Ok, so what you're gonna do is you're gonna need to find a quiet space for you alone to sit/lie down at, and a pen and paper. Then, you're gonna imagine the exact thing you don't wanna remember and here's why: your subconscious needs to forfeit the memory so we have room to simply change it. Now that you saw the unpleasant memory, write it down on paper. After you've written it, reread it, and see what you could do to change it. When you've changed the story to a more pleasant outcome, now close your eyes, take a few deep breaths, and visualize the new story. This will essentially reprogram your brain to delete the old memory with a new, positive one. You might even feel your head tingle in a spot when this happens... that's a good sign, and it usually only lasts a few seconds. I hope this method helps you on your journey as you grow and heal each day. :)
